name: Lights Out with David Spade
description: Specializing in celebrities, entertainment and all things apolitical, comedy legend David Spade and a panel of his comedian friends are at the roundtable and in the field to help break down the biggest headlines of the day.

videos.title: Neal Brennan, Erik Griffin & Whitney Cummings
videos.overview: A Pennsylvania teen wins the Fortnite World Cup, Netflix loses subscribers, and Neal Brennan, Erik Griffin and Whitney Cummings discuss the fate of Instagram likes.

videos.title: Theo Von, Jen Kirkman, Candice Thompson & Amy Schumer
videos.overview: Theo Von, Jen Kirkman and Candice Thompson discuss childless adults at Disney World and guess which stars charge the most for Cameo videos, and Amy Schumer calls in.

videos.title: Jim Jefferies, Kaley Cuoco & Steve Byrne
videos.overview: Kristen Stewart claims to hear ghosts, Uber lays off hundreds of employees, and Jim Jefferies, Kaley Cuoco and Steve Byrne discuss the drama-filled "Bachelorette" finale.

videos.title: Dana Carvey, Al Madrigal & Sarah Tiana
videos.overview: Dana Carvey, Al Madrigal and Sarah Tiana discuss the fate of Woodstock 50 and the alleged end of the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show, and Carvey shows off his impressions.

videos.title: Moshe Kasher, Natasha Leggero, Chelsea Peretti & Tina Fey
videos.overview: Moshe Kasher, Natasha Leggero and Chelsea Peretti discuss like-hunters on Instagram and a “Bachelorette” contestant’s new romance, and Tina Fey catches up with David Spade.

videos.title: Fortune Feimster, Nick Kroll & Ian Edwards
videos.overview: Fortune Feimster, Nick Kroll and Ian Edwards discuss a rogue bat on a Spirit Airlines flight and Kylie Jenner's over-the-top gift, and show writer Bobby Miyamoto calls in.

videos.title: Kevin Nealon, Guy Branum & Christina Pazsitzky
videos.overview: Kevin Nealon, Guy Branum and Christina Pazsitzky discuss Bella Hadid and The Weeknd's split and Channing Tatum's social media hiatus, and Spade checks in with Johnny the PA.

videos.title: Pete Holmes, Tony Rock & Chelsea Davison
videos.overview: Pete Holmes, Tony Rock and Chelsea Davison discuss Nicolas Cage's bizarre New York Times interview and a farmer's unique proposal, and Spade chats with actor Danny Trejo.

videos.title: Wayne Brady, Tim Dillon & Lauren Lapkus
videos.overview: Wayne Brady, Tim Dillon and Lauren Lapkus discuss Caitlyn Jenner's birthday gaffe and an intoxicated flight attendant's arrest, and Spade creates his own diet tea.

videos.title: Dennis Miller, Jo Koy, Punkie Johnson & Lara Beitz
videos.overview: Dennis Miller, Jo Koy and Punkie Johnson discuss Alex Rodriguez's robbery and NFL star Jalen Ramsey's intimidation tactics, and comedian Lara Beitz gripes about dating.

videos.title: Ron Funches, Chris Franjola, Megan Gailey & Jon Lovitz
videos.overview: Ron Funches, Chris Franjola and Megan Gailey weigh in on Drake's "Abbey Road" tattoo and Mike Tyson's $40,000 monthly weed bill, and Jon Lovitz stops by.

videos.title: Robin Thede, Todd Glass, Josh Wolf & Stassi Schroeder
videos.overview: Robin Thede, Todd Glass and Josh Wolf discuss Simon Cowell's new look and Conor McGregor's alleged bar fight, and Stassi Schroeder chats about her first attempt at stand-up.

videos.title: Bill Hader, Henry Winkler, D'Arcy Carden & Stephen Root
videos.overview: Spade chats with “Barry” cast members Bill Hader, Henry Winkler, D'Arcy Carden and Stephen Root, and Rob Schneider reprises an iconic character from “Saturday Night Live.”

videos.title: Dave Attell, Isla Fisher, Greg Fitzsimmons & Carrot Top
videos.overview: Dave Attell, Isla Fisher and Greg Fitzsimmons react to a celebrity breakup and a report on drug use among dolphins, and Carrot Top drops in for a rapid-fire prop fest.

videos.title: Nikki Glaser, Bert Kreischer & Todd Barry
videos.overview: Panelists Nikki Glaser, Bert Kreischer and Todd Barry react to an Instagram hoax that duped several celebrities and chat about the latest cast of “Dancing with the Stars.”

videos.title: Sarah Tiana, Thomas Lennon, Arturo Castro & Mumford & Sons
videos.overview: Sarah Tiana, Thomas Lennon and Arturo Castro discuss colorful developments in the world of Major League Baseball, and Mumford & Sons interviews to become Spade's house band.

videos.title: Jon Lovitz, Lauren Sivan & Pete Holmes
videos.overview: Jon Lovitz, Lauren Sivan and Pete Holmes discuss Kendall Jenner's Fyre Festival lawsuit and a Catholic school’s “Harry Potter” ban, and Chelsea Davison chats about the Emmys.

videos.title: Steve Rannazzisi, Kyle Dunnigan & Margaret Cho
videos.overview: Cocaine washes up on a beach in Florida, Heidi Klum gets an odd birthday gift, and Steve Rannazzisi, Kyle Dunnigan and Margaret Cho discuss Ariana Grande's Forever 21 lawsuit.

videos.title: Anthony Jeselnik, J.B. Smoove & Annie Lederman
videos.overview: Anthony Jeselnik, J.B. Smoove and Annie Lederman weigh in on drag queen Farrah Moan's beef with Ariana Grande and a sexy pollution film, and NBA star Nick Young does stand-up.

videos.title: Judd Apatow, Brett Gelman & Chance the Rapper
videos.overview: Judd Apatow, Brett Gelman & Chance the Rapper look at some of their favorite outfits from New York Fashion Week and discuss Kanye's Sunday service, and Chance explains why rappers don't wear jewelry.

videos.title: Bhad Bhabie, Donnell Rawlings & Guy Branum
videos.overview: Bhad Bhabie, Donnell Rawlings and Guy Branum discuss Lindsay Lohan's return to music and Nicki Minaj's retirement, and Spade goes behind-the-scenes on “Bachelor in Paradise.”

videos.title: Jay Leno, Natasha Leggero & Norm MacDonald
videos.overview: Jay Leno, Natasha Leggero and Norm Macdonald discuss self-driving cars and offer Spade advice about hosting a late-night show, and pro-racecar driver Kurt Busch stops by.

videos.title: Mary Lynn Rajskub, Randy Sklar, Jason Sklar & Rascal Flatts
videos.overview: Mary Lynn Rajskub, Randy Sklar and Jason Sklar discuss Mike Sorrentino's release from prison and LeBron James's odd trademark request, and Rascal Flatts sits down with Spade.

videos.title: Bill Burr & Jim Jefferies
videos.overview: Bill Burr and Jim Jefferies discuss Shane Gillis's “Saturday Night Live” firing and Felicity Huffman’s jail sentence, and Spade goes backstage at the Roast of Alec Baldwin.

videos.title: Brad Williams, Rob Schneider, Jen Kirkman & Brian Simpson
videos.overview: Brad Williams, Rob Schneider and Jen Kirkman discuss Kanye West's choice not to let his daughter use makeup, Bobby Lee calls in, and comedian Brian Simpson performs.

videos.title: Jim Gaffigan, Sarah Tiana, Fred Armisen & Sean Penn
videos.overview: Jim Gaffigan, Sarah Tiana and Fred Armisen discuss the newest contestant on “The Bachelor” and Antonio Brown’s odd doctor's visits, and Spade gets a tattoo from Sean Penn.

videos.title: Nikki Glaser, Drew Carey & Fortune Feimster
videos.overview: Nikki Glaser, Drew Carey and Fortune Feimster talk about relationship rumors surrounding two “Dancing with the Stars” contestants and give their take on a secret crush app.

videos.title: Maria Bamford, Erik Griffin & Joel McHale
videos.overview: Maria Bamford, Erik Griffin and Joel McHale discuss Peter Dinklage’s Emmy win, “Fleabag" star Brett Gelman calls in, and former Navy SEAL Robert O'Neill tries stand-up.

videos.title: Christina P., Michael Rapaport & Dulce Sloan
videos.overview: Christina P., Michael Rapaport and Dulce Sloan discuss Lindsay Lohan’s “Xanax” music video, Jennifer Lawrence’s Amazon wedding registry and a viral gender reveal stunt.

videos.title: Greg Fitzsimmons, Bill Engvall & Annie Lederman
videos.overview: Greg Fitzsimmons, Bill Engvall and Annie Lederman discuss Jon Cryer’s virginity rumors and a Tekashi 69 docuseries, and Spade moonlights on “Bachelor in Paradise.”

videos.title: Ian Edwards, Tim Dillon & Matt Walsh
videos.overview: Spade riffs on Tekashi 6ix9ine refusing witness protection, and Ian Edwards, Tim Dillon and Matt Walsh discuss Jennifer Lopez's Super Bowl halftime gig.

videos.title: Erin Foster, Sara Foster & Kevin Nealon
videos.overview: Erin Foster, Sara Foster and Kevin Nealon discuss Justin Bieber and Hailey Baldwin's wedding, Aaron Carter's new face tattoo and Miley Cyrus's spat with her mom.

videos.title: Tony Rock, Patton Oswalt & Lauren Sivan
videos.overview: Tony Rock, Patton Oswalt and Lauren Sivan discuss a California law benefitting college athletes and Kevin Durant's birthday party, and Spade honors lesser-known sports stars.

videos.title: Maya Rudolph & Martin Short
videos.overview: Spade dishes on Kanye West's accidental album release, and Maya Rudolph and Martin Short discuss helicopter parents and a vendor accused of scamming football fans.

videos.title: Deon Cole, Todd Glass & Cristela Alonzo
videos.overview: Deon Cole, Todd Glass and Cristela Alonzo discuss Robert De Niro's legal woes and a viral subway opera singer, and Spade adds sound effects to Liz Carey's street interviews.

videos.title: Candice Thompson, Rob Corddry & Chris Franjola
videos.overview: Candice Thompson, Rob Corddry and Chris Franjola discuss “Joker,” Justin Bieber's feud with PETA and a trend of celebrities giving out their phone numbers on social media.

videos.title: Megan Gailey, Chris Jericho & Brett Gelman
videos.overview: Megan Gailey, Chris Jericho and Brett Gelman discuss Instagram's latest update and Kylie Jenner's $3 million car, and Bobby Miyamoto performs.

videos.title: Leighton Meester, Taran Killam & Brad Garrett
videos.overview: Leighton Meester, Taran Killam and Brad Garrett of “Single Parents” discuss Drake's feud with his dad and a bridesmaid-for-hire service, and Spade's mom critiques the show.

videos.title: Ron Funches, Adam DeVine & Alexandra Shipp
videos.overview: “Jexi” stars Ron Funches, Adam DeVine and Alexandra Shipp discuss a “Sesame Street” addiction storyline and Uber’s pet-friendly service, and Spade goes to an Eagles concert.

videos.title: Eleanor Kerrigan, Brad Williams & Adam Ray
videos.overview: Eleanor Kerrigan, Brad Williams and Adam Ray discuss Taylor Swift’s jinx on the L.A. Kings, Deadmau5 angles for the house DJ gig, and Spade sets out to be the next James Bond.

videos.title: Bella Thorne, Moshe Kasher, Lara Beitz & Heather Dubrow
videos.overview: Bella Thorne, Moshe Kasher and Lara Beitz discuss Zoe Kravitz's role as Catwoman and RuPaul's no-selfie rule, and "Real Housewives" star Heather Dubrow tries stand-up.

videos.title: Thomas Lennon, Whitney Cummings & Diplo
videos.overview: Thomas Lennon, Whitney Cummings and Diplo discuss Jennifer Aniston’s Instagram debut and Kourtney Kardashian’s alleged robbery, and Tim Dillon answers questions from viewers.

videos.title: Vanessa Bayer, Guy Branum & Dusty Slay
videos.overview: Vanessa Bayer, Guy Branum and Dusty Slay discuss Jennifer Lawrence’s upcoming wedding, a major cheese theft incident in California and the rise of baby raves.

videos.title: Liza Treyger, Kevin Nealon & Dean Delray
videos.overview: Liza Treyger, Kevin Nealon and Dean Delray discuss Ben Affleck's online dating profile and a cringeworthy update of the alphabet song, and Spade recalls his fraternity days.

videos.title: Christina P., Jon Lovitz, Benji Aflalo & Charlotte McKinney
videos.overview: Christina P., Jon Lovitz and Benji Aflalo discuss Kanye West’s upcoming tour, Spade chats with a young Chris Farley fan, and Charlotte McKinney makes her stand-up debut.

videos.title: Sarah Tiana, Louie Anderson & Joey Diaz
videos.overview: Sarah Tiana, Louie Anderson and Joey Diaz discuss Facebook's ban on sexual emojis and the University of Oxford's applause policy, and Spade explains internet slang to his mom.

videos.title: Tony Hale, Fortune Feimster & Josh Wolf
videos.overview: Spade riffs on Kim Kardashian's Halloween plans, and Tony Hale, Fortune Feimster and Josh Wolf discuss an MLB fan's $13 million losing bet and Kanye West's Instagram plight.

videos.overview: Celeste Barber and the Sklar Brothers discuss Kanye West's pricey brunch and a shake-up at McDonald's, and Spade reveals his role on "The Real Housewives of Orange County."

videos.overview: Spade talks about Harry and Meghan, Elon Musk, the host-less Oscars, Harry Potter merchandising and spiders with Niki Glaser, Sarah Tiana and Tony Rock.

videos.title: Lara Beitz, Jeremiah Watkins, & Kevin Nealon
videos.overview: The Oscar nominations, Gwyneth Paltrow's vagina scented candle, Meghan and Harry, No pants day and Drake's diamond necklace are David Spade's topics for Lara Beitz, Jeremiah Watkins and Kevin Nealon.

videos.title: Jim Gaffigan, Chris Hardwick, & Whitney Cummings
videos.overview: Champagne-gate on The Bachelor, Meghan Markle and Instagram banning Photoshop are discussed by David Spade and his panel Jim Gaffigan, Chris Hardwick and Whitney Cummings.

videos.overview: Newcomer Jameela Jamil joins regular panelists Fortune Feimster and Greg Fitzsimmons. Spade Runs TV reveals the BTS secrets of Keeping Up with the Kardashians.

videos.title: Lizzy Cooperman, Guy Branum, & Joel McHale
videos.overview: Lizzy Cooperman joins show veterans Guy Branum and Joel McHale on David Spade's panel. Topics include spanking in the locker room, Mark Wahlberg's workout routine and actors doing their own stunts. Chris Franjola chimes in on Harry and Meghan as he used to work with her at a restaurant. Spade shows his deleted contribution to Rob Lowe's new show 9-1-1: Lone Star.

videos.title: Punkie, Brad, & Erik
videos.overview: David Spade looks at the news with Punkie, Brad and Erik. Stand up comic Dylan Sullivan does a tight five spot.

videos.title: Annie Lederman, Doug Benson, & Steve Rannazzisi
videos.overview: Annie Lederman, Doug Benson and Steve Rannazzisi are on David Spade's panel, Nick Viall does Secret Standup.

videos.title: Yamaneika Saunders, Tim Dillon, & Andrew Santino
videos.overview: David Spade's panel consists of Yamaneika Saunders, Tim Dillon and Andrew Santino. Also featured are some handy Spade Hacks.

videos.title: Kira Soltanovich, Brendan Schaub, & Chris Franjola
videos.overview: On the panel are Kira Soltanovich, Brendan Schaub and Chris Franjola. David Spade shows his audition for Dolittle (2020) and gives his Grammy acceptance speech.

videos.title: Nicole Aimee Schreiber, Tony Rock & Adam Ray
videos.overview: Spade hands out the topics to Nicole Aimée Schreiber, Tony Rock and Adam Ray. Mosquito Wireless CEO and show sponsor Rick Montana also gets some airtime.

videos.title: Christina P., Moche Kasher, & Preacher Lawson
videos.overview: Regular panelists Christina P. and Moche Kasher welcome first timer Preacher Lawson to David's show. Lil' John appears as a Super Bowl Correspondent.

videos.title: Brent Morin, Megan Gailey, & Benji Aflalo
videos.overview: Spade's panel is made up out of Brent Morin, Megan Gailey and Benji Aflalo. The upcoming Superbowl and Oscars are discussed, as well as a fighting Minnie Mouse.

videos.title: Dana Goul, Cristela Alonzo, & Pete Homles
videos.overview: David Spade and Dana Gould compare Johnny Carson impressions. Cristela Alonzo is proud of her Latino roots, Pete Holmes less so about his Boston ones. Spade Runs TV looks BTS at the Puppy Bowl.

videos.title: Rachel Mac & the Sklar Brothers
videos.overview: Rachel Mac has graduated from the Tight Five spot to joining the Sklar brothers on the panel. David chaperon's writer Bobby Miyamoto on a pretend date with Hannah B.

videos.title: Ron Fuches, Jo Koy, & Morgan Stewart
videos.overview: Spade moderates his panel consisting of Ron Fuches, Jo Koy and Morgan Stewart. Lights Out Pop Culture Lawyer Guy Branum also puts in his two cents.

videos.title: Annie Lederman, Justine Martindale, & Mark Ellis
videos.overview: Together with Annie Lederman, Justin Martindale and Mark Ellis, David Spade previews the Oscars and other pop culture news. Also: Lights Out Sports Update and Spade's to do list.

videos.title: Fortune Feimster, Sam Morril, & Sarah Tiana
videos.overview: Spade has no more monologue up front but goes straight into the panel, discussing the Oscars with Fortune Feimster, 'Joker' star Sam Morril and about to take maternity leave Sarah Tiana. Candice Thompson reports on 'Unfollowgate'.

videos.title: Beth Stelling, Tim Dillon, & Ian Edwards
videos.overview: More Oscar insights and other showbiz news is discussed by David Spade and his panel Beth Stelling, Tim Dillon and Ian Edwards. Also a behind the scenes look at the red carpet and finally, Spade's parting shots.

videos.title: Josh Wolf
videos.overview: Frequent guest Josh Wolf appears. This was a solid, if unspectacular, episode. It was entertaining, but far from the series' best outing.

videos.title: Jim Carrey
videos.overview: David Spade has a one on one interview with Jim Carrey, who is there to promote Sonic the Hedgehog.

videos.title: Guilia Rozzi, Chris Franjola, & Tony Rock
videos.overview: David Spade, Giulia Rozzi, Chris Franjola and Tony Rock talk about the big short fight, social media scandals, weird fashion and Tony Montana (Dana Carvey) educates everyone about the Caronavirus.

videos.title: Dave Attell & Jeff Ross
videos.overview: Dave Attell and Jeff Ross are David Spade's guests and give a sampling of the kind of crowd work they do during their 'Bumping Mics' tour.

videos.title: Adam Ray, Megan Gailey, & Guy Branum
videos.overview: David Spade and his panel of regulars: Adam Ray, Megan Gailey and Guy Branum talk about Just Harry and silly baby names. Sarah Tiana, having just given birth calls in on this subject. Also, poop talk.

videos.title: Liza Treyger, Andrew Santino, & Russell Peters
videos.overview: Liza Treyger, Andrew Santino and Russell Peters are on the panel. Spade Runs TV reveals the behind the scenes process at 'Survivor'.

videos.title: Arielle Vandenberg, Erik Griffin, & Josh Wolf
videos.overview: The show's 100th episode was HILARIOUS, with Arielle Vandenberg, Erik Griffin, and frequent guest Josh Wolf providing the laughs.

videos.title: Candice Thompson & the Sklar Brothers
videos.overview: Candice Thompson and the Sklar brothers are on David's panel. Tim Dillon, Lights Out PR guy answers more Show Questions.

videos.title: Greg Fitzsimmons, Beth Stelling & Moshe Kasher
videos.overview: This show featured cameos by the entire cast of JUST SHOOT ME, the sitcom David Spade was in on NBC.

videos.title: Courtney Cox & Cesar Millan
videos.overview: David Spade really turned up the celebrity cameos this week. This show featured appearances by Courtney Cox and Cesar Millan (The Dog Whisperer). It was an entertaining half hour, but nowhere near the show's best outing.

videos.title: Joe Koy, Chris HArdwick, & Yamaneika Saunders
videos.overview: Joe Koy, Chris Hardwick, and Yamaneika Saunders were the guests on this one, and Spade continued his string of recent celebrity cameo appearances with a long one involving Sean Hayes of Will and Grace. A fairly decent outing.

videos.title: Megan Gailey, Chris Franjola, & Gabriel Iglesias
videos.overview: Lights Out veterans Megan Gailey and Chris Franjola are joined on the panel by newcomer Gabriel Iglesias. Spade Runs TV shows the behind the scenes happenings at Love and Hip Hop: Atlanta.

videos.title: Tony Rock, Cristela Alonzo & Jim Jefferies
videos.overview: David Spade's obsession with The Bachelor turns his show into the Season 24 finale After Show. The panel even gets to question friend-of-the-show Chris Harrison about it.

videos.overview: Panelists Zainab Johnson, Nikki Glaser and Fortune Feimster join David Spade to talk about the latest in pop culture.
